summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Changes: new monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist (stdlib only, type-hinted, Google-style docstring); explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py; "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst; new tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist covering test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, and test_seg_no_labels. Nothing was committed and no tests or scripts were run, per instructions. Black and flake8 are not installed; I measured line lengths instead and no line exceeds 120 columns, but the formatting has not been checked by Black. Choices beyond the spec: non-dict top-level JSON and non-list key values raise ValueError; a missing image or label is left unresolved and absent from the output.
